## What this revision establishes

This revision completes the **kernel proof of bounded reverse return**, removes the entire two-odd upper-certificate layer of a least reverse defect, and delivers a Lean closing proposal with **one explicit open mathematical input**. **It does not prove Collatz.**

**[Scientific packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/README.md)** · **[final Lean proposal](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/FinalProofProposal.lean)** · **[execution and reviews](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/README.md)** · **[repository reassessment](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/REEVALUATION.md)**.

The work extends baseline `7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536`. Four GPT-6.2 Astra streams developed and cross-reviewed arithmetic, source transport, local resampling and a new positive contraction. The publisher rebuilt all local Lean objects and replayed every new certificate family. The metadata refresh inventories 143 open PRs; focused mathematical comparisons are recorded separately and do not constitute an audit of every branch.

## 1. Bounded return is now an unconditional kernel theorem

For the ordinary positive shortcut map, let C denote the basin of 1. A reverse defect is w = 17 mod48 with C(3w) and not C(w). Lean now proves:

```text
n > 0 and not C(n)
  imply there is a reverse defect w with w <= 2^40 n.
```

`CollatzQuantitativeReturn.bounded_return` rebuilds the old directed localization with the **original affine source, full history and both coefficient bounds retained**. Seventy-five ternary subbanks and their outer tree cover the full residue-16 source. A separate finite checker covers every one of the pinned 26 odd-source descent leaves. Ordinary segments preserve the basin label, a first successful tripling gives the required ordered witness, and a completed nonbasin batch is strictly smaller. Strong induction proves the bound for every positive ordinary input. No P, R, M or external renewal hypothesis enters this theorem.

The proof data are embedded in [QuantitativeReturn.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/QuantitativeReturn.lean). A separate normal/optimized replay reconstructs them from the original source banks. This discharges a premise that was written-only earlier in this pass.

## 2. The complete two-odd layer is closed

For z = 17 mod48, the first two inputs from 3z are odd. If its convergence certificate has only those two odd inputs, then 27z+5=4*2^e. Below e=201 the only eligible exponents are 39,93,147; the three lower starts reach 1 in 168,398,677 clocks. Above that cutoff, 203 actual lower shortcut steps reach a positive n with 2^40*n<z and the same basin membership.

The theorem `CollatzTwoOdd.two_odd_progress` proves this progress unconditionally. The new bounded return then rules out this entire layer at a least reverse defect. The least-defect argument never assumes that every smaller ordinary integer converges.

The checked final assembly is now:

```lean
theorem collatz_from_proposal
    (higher : HigherRankProgress) : UniversalConvergence

theorem collatz_iff_higher_rank :
    UniversalConvergence ↔ HigherRankProgress
```

`HigherRankProgress` remains **OPEN**. It asks for the same ordinary progress at every source whose triple has a finite certificate with at least three odd inputs. The equivalence deliberately records the full strength of the missing theorem. No proof of that theorem is supplied or hidden as an axiom.

## 3. Three-odd structure and a positive contraction

A written finite-certificate argument restricts the even gap between the second and third odd inputs of a least reverse defect to 6 through 48. It uses 156 contracting finite rational parity words and 675 completely checked small-tail ordinary sources. This restriction retains written-proof status.

For one family, a=98+162m and 81z+527=512*2^a, Lean checks the complete upper certificate and C(z) iff C(2^a-1). If z is least, forty directed paths with 80 strictly smaller queries and an ordinary even-exponent merger force the first bad Mersenne exponent to be **j=97+162m**.

The new [opposite-arm contraction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/OPPOSITE_ARM_CONTRACTION.md) excludes further infinite classes. For every j=29419+354294k, Lean constructs positive w,z = 17 mod48 such that

```text
81z+527 = 2^(j+10),       w < z,
T^21(w) = 2^j-1,
T^24(3w) = 2^(j-3)+1,
2^40 T^224(3w) < z.
```

The last endpoint must be in the basin at a globally least reverse defect, by the now-proved return theorem. This makes w a still smaller reverse defect, a contradiction. The whole literal bank has 214 disjoint progressions: it excludes **1,000 of 59,049** exponent classes, with 616 power endpoints and 384 positive contractions. **58,049 remain outside this bank.** It also does not cover the other three-odd families or all higher ranks.

The packet separately proves finite-horizon limitations in Lean: no uniform ordinary merger deadline works, and a three-odd upper certificate can finish while the lower source has stayed above 9/16 of its initial height. These do not exclude later source-dependent or directed descent.

## 4. Parallel analytic work and latest sources

The local-resampling result retains almost all of a selected inverse-polynomial population and finds thick opposite replies at many genuine regeneration clocks, under the prior source-qualified P and R inputs. The finite Lean core checks the resulting ordinary orbit-graph obstruction and lattice stride. Under the additional density input M, a counterexample forces graph deficiency on infinitely many rows; the contradictory same-row upper bound remains open. Polynomial index range is not asserted to be polynomial ordinary diameter.

The source-transport note preserves the actual fixed-gate clock and common future. The late comparison with PR207 at b56c4dc2c28a184cf55638bb80c49a9d4662fc81 shows that its aggregate lower bound and upper localization leave compatible intermediate suffix lengths. Its nontrivial-cycle lower and upper bounds operate in different shell regimes. Its imported renewal floor remains qualified and its companion Lean is labeled uncompiled at that head. The later PR206 Proposal.md at b2b56b94175174a680a296478f16c619a8828972 explicitly leaves its forward-clock and finite-cycle-test conditions open; its companion Lean was not rebuilt here.

The method continues the Aaronson–Yolcu–Heule exact rewrite/termination viewpoint through independently checked finite ordinary words. It does not claim a terminating interpretation of their full rewrite system. The prior PR197 results remain preserved; the [previous PR description](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/PRIOR_PR_DESCRIPTION.json) is archived.

## Executed verification

- Final fresh Lean 4.34.1 build with Mathlib d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612: **17 mathematical modules plus PublicAudit**, all local objects rebuilt, one worker, automatic implicit binders disabled, warnings as errors. Exit 0 in **512.901 seconds**.
- **100 explicitly audited public declarations**: 70 earlier dependency statements and 30 new statements. Every axiom list is a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Explicit theorem inputs remain inputs.
- Five finite checkers passed both normal and optimized Python with identical paired stdout. A separately authored verifier checked 31,847 actual ordinary clocks across all 214 first family members and pairwise class disjointness. All eleven recorded executions exited 0.
- Independent reviews pin their exact source bytes. The final quantitative theorem was also compiled independently by its author and imported by a separate client. The publisher's complete fresh run is distinct from those events.

[Final build receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/lean-execution.json) · [100-declaration audit](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/axiom-audit.json) · [finite executions](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/finite-execution.json) · [independent assembly review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/FINAL_PROPOSAL_REVIEW.md) · [source hashes](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b27a6fe31a487adf5615e173329ad009b975a3cd/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/closing-proposal/source-hashes.json).

The remotely assembled tree matched the local committed tree before the branch moved. Git fetch and a separate remote ref read confirmed the published head. In a clean complete checkout of that exact head, all five required default validator commands passed. The checkout remained clean. No optional regression bundle was run in this pass. Integrity checks do not establish the mathematical closing step.
